title: Version and validate evolution of a Tarium ontology
abstract: When changing public ontology concepts, identifiers, relationships or semantics, document version changes, check reference integrity, preserve compatible identifiers where applicable and explicitly record migration or incompatibility requirements.

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only explicitly authorized work on independent public Tarium projects

remarks: Public-source rule normalization reviewed as a distinct project-specific atom; overlapping general rules retained.
